The only mention of your shampoo says it's a lavender-scented one you bought at Trader Joe's. No other brand name was given, so it is most likely Trader Joe's own store brand. Nothing since then suggests you switched.

**Answer:** You currently use a lavender-scented shampoo from Trader Joe's, most likely their own brand, which you said has been doing wonders for your hair.
